Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

3.3 Detailed dimensions of the point and cutting angles shall be at the discretion of manufacturer ( see 
also IS : 5099-1 969 for recommendation regarding ' tool type ' ). 

3.4*The tolerance on drill diameter d shall be measured as near the point as practicable. 

3.5 Dimensions of bores and cross-slot shall be according to IS : 5568-1970 'Tenon^and cross-slots 
for tools wtth bore taper 1 : 30 '. 

3.6 Dimensions for arbors shall be according to IS : 5936-1970 ' Arbors with morse taper shanks for 
shell tools '. 

3.7 In regard to the requirements not covered in this standard, it shall conform to the requirements of 
18:5099-1969. 

4. DMignation 

4.1 A shell core drill having diameter 40 mm ' tool type ' N, for right-hand cutting, conforming to this 
standard and made of high speed steel (HSS) shall be designated as: 

Shell Core Drill 40 IS : 7772 HSS 

4.2 When a shell core drill is required with tool type other than N, an appropriate 'tool type' H or S 
shall be added in the designation immediately after the size. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Method of Checking Taper Sore — Taper bore in shell core drill is checked by measuring the 
tolerance on diameter di. The tolerance is determined by the amount of the permissible variation a^ in 
the gauge plane of the taper bore. The value a^ represents the depth to which a taper plug gauge of 
the appropriate nominal size may enter the drill to be checked with respect to its gauge plane. 

5.2 The maximum and minimum values of a^ shall be as given below:

8. Sampling —The sampling and criteria for acceptance shall be in accordance with IS : 7778-1975 
' Methods for sampling small tools '. 

7. Certification Mariiing — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is in full confonnity with ISO/DIS 3314 ' Shell drills with tiiper bore (taper 1 : 30 
included ) with slot drive' issued by the International Organization for Standardization. The preferred 
sizes given in 2.t are the same as recommended stocked sizes of shell drills given in ISO/DIS 3314.
